title: ORCHESTRA paper CPU userspace metrics CSV v4
maturity_class: userspace-validated telemetry with experimental burst-sensitive temporal-stability diagnostics
status: Linux remains the scheduler. This schema records bounded userspace observations and experimental coordination diagnostics; it does not establish kernel dispatch, scheduler compliance, or scheduler-performance evidence.

compatibility.v2: The first 40 columns retain the immutable orchestra.paper_cpu.metrics/v2 meanings.
compatibility.v3: The first 66 columns retain the strict orchestra.paper_cpu.metrics/v3 meanings and order.
compatibility.v4_append_only: Columns 67 through 83 are append-only v4 burst diagnostics. A v4 reader must require the exact ordered 83-column header and the metrics_schema identifier on every row.
compatibility.analysis: Do not silently combine v2, v3, and v4 rows in one statistical summary. Re-run and analyze each schema version under its own declared protocol.
compatibility.v5_append_only: Columns 84 through 107 are append-only v5 controller state machine diagnostics. A v5 reader must require the exact ordered 107-column header and the metrics_schema identifier on every row.

q_definition: Historical Q remains Q=(S1*S2*S3*S4)^(1/4); if any factor is zero, Q is exactly zero. S4_burst is experimental and is not included in Q.

zero_denominator_policy.S2_selected: 1 when eligible_workers is 0, matching historical S2.
zero_denominator_policy.S2_effective: 1 when eligible_workers is 0; 0 when eligible_workers is positive but no action attempt was observed.
zero_denominator_policy.action_specific_fractions: 1 when the corresponding attempt count is 0 (not applicable, not proof of success).
zero_denominator_policy.S4_burst: 1 when eligible_workers is 0 or changed_eligible_workers is 0; no burst behavior is observable.
zero_denominator_policy.justified_change_fraction: 0 when changed_eligible_workers is 0; no change exists to justify.
zero_denominator_policy.dominant_transition: dominant_old_action and dominant_new_action are both -1, and dominant_transition_count is 0, when changed_eligible_workers is 0.
zero_denominator_policy.rolling_window: oscillation_penalty, rolling_window_burst_count, rolling_window_oscillation_count, large_burst_event, and repeated_oscillation_event are 0 when there is no current large burst.

burst_metric.status: experimental; it is a bounded userspace policy-selection diagnostic, not a theoretically final coordination metric or kernel scheduling measurement.

actions.-1: no dominant transition sentinel only when changed_eligible_workers is 0

burst_metric.transition_matrix: transition_counts[old_action][new_action] is a fixed 5 by 5 counter matrix for eligible workers whose current selected action differs from their prior selected action. Diagonal cells are excluded from changed_eligible_workers and from dominance.
burst_metric.change_fraction: changed_eligible_workers / eligible_workers, or 0 for zero eligible workers.
burst_metric.dominant_transition_fraction: dominant_transition_count / changed_eligible_workers, or 0 when there are no changed eligible workers. Ties select the lexicographically first canonical old/new action pair for deterministic diagnostics.
burst_metric.directive_justification: A changed worker is justified only when the current and previous directives are both fully accepted and fresh, the directives differ, and the worker's new selected action equals the current directive. Current validity additionally requires no current worker fallback. Rejected, stale, unauthenticated, unavailable, partial, or fallback-bearing directives cannot justify a change.
burst_metric.justified_change_fraction: justified_changed_workers / changed_eligible_workers, or 0 when there are no changes.
burst_metric.population_scale: 0 when eligible_workers <= 1 or changed_eligible_workers <= 1; otherwise (changed_eligible_workers - 1) / (eligible_workers - 1). This prevents one worker from being treated as a synchronized population burst.
burst_metric.formula: S4_burst=clamp(1 - 0.80 * change_fraction * population_scale * dominant_transition_fraction * (0.20 + 0.80 * (1 - justified_change_fraction)) - oscillation_penalty, 0, 1).
burst_metric.large_burst_rule: large_burst_event is 1 when changed_eligible_workers > 1, change_fraction >= 0.50, and dominant_transition_fraction >= 0.75; otherwise 0.
burst_metric.history: A fixed physical history of eight accepted-frame entries is maintained without allocation; every entry records whether its frame contained a large burst. The diagnostic considers only prior entries marked large with accepted-frame sequence distance at most 4. rolling_window_burst_count includes the current large burst and is bounded 0..5. rolling_window_oscillation_count counts only prior candidate events whose dominant old/new pair exactly reverses the current pair and is bounded 0..4. repeated_oscillation_event is 1 exactly when the current event is large and rolling_window_oscillation_count is positive. History updates only for fully accepted current directives.
burst_metric.complexity: O(N + A^2) time per observation for N eligible workers and A=5 canonical actions; O(A^2 + 8) fixed auxiliary space.

metric_identities.S2: S2 == S2_selected == selected directive matches / eligible_workers, with the stated zero-eligible rule.
metric_identities.S4: S4 == 1 - changed_eligible_workers / eligible_workers when eligible_workers is positive; it is 1 when eligible_workers is 0. Historical S4 is unchanged.
metric_identities.S4_burst: The documented experimental burst formula using the v4 components; it is not part of historical Q.
metric_identities.S2_effective: effective_action_success_count / eligible_workers, with the stated zero-eligible rule.
metric_identities.migration_observed_success_fraction: migration_observed_success_count / migration_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.sleep_effectiveness_fraction: sleep_effective_success_count / sleep_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.yield_call_success_fraction: yield_call_success_count / yield_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.throttle_operation_success_fraction: throttle_operation_success_count / throttle_attempt_count, with the stated action-specific zero-attempt rule.
metric_identities.fallback_fraction: fallback_workers / eligible_workers when eligible_workers is positive.

columns.name: tick
columns.semantic: Unchanged from v3: one-based parent publication count.

columns.name: mode
columns.semantic: Unchanged from v3: legacy prototype execution mode.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not select a Linux scheduling class.

columns.name: cpu_now
columns.claim_limitation: Host observation, not per-task dispatch state.

columns.name: decision_cpu
columns.semantic: Unchanged observed or predicted CPU used for directive selection.

columns.name: prediction_used
columns.semantic: Unchanged indicator that decision_cpu used cpu_pred.

columns.name: frame_age_ms
columns.semantic: Unchanged parent-observed monotonic age of applied frame.

columns.name: sleep
columns.claim_limitation: Selection does not prove elapsed sleep.

columns.name: throttle
columns.claim_limitation: Selection does not prove CPU-capacity reduction.

columns.name: yield
columns.claim_limitation: Selection does not prove another task ran.

columns.name: eligible_workers
columns.semantic: Unchanged alive non-exempt workers with coherent snapshots.

columns.name: fallback_workers
columns.semantic: Unchanged eligible workers in bounded userspace fallback.
columns.claim_limitation: Not a conventional Linux scheduler fallback.

columns.name: S1
columns.semantic: Unchanged signal fidelity and freshness metric.

columns.name: S2
columns.semantic: Historical selected-action directive compliance; exact alias of S2_selected.

columns.name: S3
columns.semantic: Historical global entropy action coherence; exact alias of S3_global.

columns.name: S4
columns.semantic: Historical selected-action temporal stability, unchanged as 1-changed/eligible.

columns.name: Q
columns.semantic: Historical geometric mean of S1, S2, S3, and S4.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not include S4_burst and is not a performance score.

columns.name: controller_updated
columns.claim_limitation: Not a complete controller-safety state machine.

columns.name: controller_beta
columns.semantic: Unchanged controller step size on an update.

columns.name: missed_deadlines
columns.claim_limitation: Not a kernel scheduling deadline metric.

columns.name: S3_global
columns.semantic: Unchanged explicit alias of historical S3.
columns.claim_limitation: Global action diversity is not necessarily poor coordination.

columns.name: S3_conditioned
columns.claim_limitation: Policy state IDs are not kernel scheduler classes.

columns.name: S2_selected
columns.claim_limitation: Selected requests are not kernel scheduler compliance.

columns.name: S2_effective
columns.claim_limitation: Not kernel dispatch compliance or scheduler performance.

columns.name: action_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: An attempt is not final scheduler execution.

columns.name: effective_action_success_count
columns.claim_limitation: Not a count of kernel-compliant dispatches.

columns.name: action_error_count
columns.semantic: Unchanged attempted actions with nonzero errno.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not enumerate all ineffective outcomes.

columns.name: migration_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove a completed CPU migration.

columns.name: migration_valid_requested_cpu_count
columns.semantic: Unchanged migration attempts with valid eligible CPU request.
columns.claim_limitation: A valid request does not prove affinity or migration.

columns.name: migration_affinity_success_count
columns.claim_limitation: Affinity success alone is not observed migration.

columns.name: migration_observed_success_count
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove durable placement or kernel intent.

columns.name: migration_observed_success_fraction
columns.semantic: Unchanged observed migration successes / migration attempts.

columns.name: sleep_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove scheduler sleep state.

columns.name: sleep_effective_success_count
columns.claim_limitation: Elapsed wall time is not dispatch evidence.

columns.name: requested_sleep_ns_total
columns.semantic: Unchanged total bounded requested sleep duration.
columns.claim_limitation: Not a Linux scheduler sleep total.

columns.name: observed_sleep_ns_total
columns.semantic: Unchanged total monotonic observed sleep duration.
columns.claim_limitation: Not a wake-up or dispatch measurement.

columns.name: yield_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove another task ran.

columns.name: yield_call_success_fraction
columns.semantic: Unchanged successful yield calls / yield attempts.

columns.name: throttle_attempt_count
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove a CPU cap.

columns.name: fallback_fraction
columns.claim_limitation: Not a Linux scheduler fallback fraction.

columns.name: fallback_reason
columns.claim_limitation: Not an OS scheduler failure diagnosis.

columns.name: S4_burst
columns.semantic: Experimental burst-sensitive temporal-stability score defined by burst_metric.formula and population_scale.
columns.claim_limitation: Userspace policy-selection diagnostic only; not kernel scheduling compliance, performance, or a theoretically final coordination metric.

columns.name: change_fraction
columns.semantic: Changed eligible workers divided by eligible workers; 0 with zero eligible workers.
columns.claim_limitation: Counts selected-action changes, not Linux dispatch changes.

columns.name: dominant_transition_fraction
columns.semantic: Dominant identical old-to-new selected-action transition count divided by changed eligible workers; 0 with no changes.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not observe a kernel transition.

columns.name: justified_change_fraction
columns.semantic: Justified changed workers divided by changed eligible workers; 0 with no changes. Justification requires an accepted fresh directive transition and movement to the new directive.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not validate a kernel scheduling directive or make a stale/rejected frame valid.

columns.name: oscillation_penalty
columns.claim_limitation: Experimental bounded diagnostic penalty, not a formal stability proof.

columns.name: dominant_old_action
columns.semantic: Old action in the deterministic dominant changed transition; -1 only with no changed eligible workers.
columns.claim_limitation: A userspace selected-action ID, not a kernel task state.

columns.name: dominant_new_action
columns.semantic: New action in the deterministic dominant changed transition; -1 only with no changed eligible workers.
columns.claim_limitation: A userspace selected-action ID, not a kernel task state.

columns.name: changed_eligible_workers
columns.semantic: Eligible workers whose current selected action differs from their prior selected action.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not count actual kernel dispatch or state transitions.

columns.name: justified_changed_workers
columns.semantic: Changed workers that meet the v4 accepted-directive-transition justification rule.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not prove kernel compliance or validate rejected/stale directives.

columns.name: dominant_transition_count
columns.semantic: Number of changed eligible workers in the dominant old-to-new selected-action pair; 0 with no changes.

columns.name: rolling_window_burst_count
columns.semantic: For a current large burst, the current event plus accepted large bursts within sequence distance 4; 0 otherwise.
columns.claim_limitation: Fixed bounded userspace history, not a distributed or kernel event stream.

columns.name: rolling_window_oscillation_count
columns.semantic: For a current large burst, prior accepted in-window dominant transitions exactly reversing it; 0 otherwise.
columns.claim_limitation: A heuristic diagnostic, not proof of a causal oscillation mechanism.

columns.name: current_directive_valid
columns.semantic: 1 only when a positive expected non-exempt population has fully eligible coherent current-frame snapshots, no current worker fallback, and the current directive was accepted and fresh; 0 otherwise.

columns.name: previous_directive_valid
columns.semantic: 1 only when a prior fully accepted fresh directive is available for comparison.
columns.claim_limitation: Does not make a current rejected or stale directive valid.

columns.name: directive_transition_valid
columns.semantic: 1 only when current_directive_valid and previous_directive_valid are 1 and their canonical directives differ.
columns.claim_limitation: An accepted userspace signal transition, not a Linux scheduler command.

columns.name: large_burst_event
columns.semantic: 1 when more than one eligible worker changed, change_fraction is at least 0.50, and dominant_transition_fraction is at least 0.75; otherwise 0.
columns.claim_limitation: Thresholded experimental diagnostic, not a scheduler-performance event.

columns.name: repeated_oscillation_event
columns.semantic: 1 exactly when the current event is a large burst and at least one accepted in-window dominant transition exactly reverses it; otherwise 0.
columns.claim_limitation: A bounded heuristic indicator, not proof of system-level oscillation.

columns.name: transition_reason
columns.semantic: Reason for the most recent state transition.

columns.name: state_residence_time
columns.semantic: Consecutive updates in the current state.

columns.name: valid_control_history_count
columns.semantic: Count of valid accepted frame updates.

columns.name: saturation_persistence
columns.semantic: Consecutive saturated updates with persisting deficit.
